t: In accordance with the recommendation of the Department of Public Works, the City and County of San Francisco accept that certain Easement Deed from the State of California, dated the 25th day of July, 1940, to a strip of land 80 feet in width…
pl: City takes state land for Holloway Avenue at San Francisco State
